text: Steenbarger: No, my trigger does not require volume at least 1.4x normal. It is my plain text: C5 is trend, normal reaction, then a new high, and the new high is the test. Volume is not my measure; day_vol 0.66 is a partial proxy and fill_difficulty is NOT_SERVED (R5), so I neither gate on it nor wave it off. Dissent cannot stay []: minervini and oneil objected and belong on it. My case stands: W and D swing HH/HL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.51, mp_state STRONG. Wrong if a one-day reaction of one atr_14d off the day's high (C7, my translation).
